title: ref/v1 frontmatter (AIP-54)
description: Validates an AIP-54 typed artifact reference — the one cross-AIP reference shape. An ArtifactRef names an artifact by its owning AIP number and that AIP's registry key, optionally pinned to a version. It replaces every per-primitive reference mechanism (AIP-18's collection-scoped refKind, inline doctype handles, AIP-53's draft appRef/packRef union, bare id strings). Resolution is host-side via AIP-43 registries joined by a RefCatalog; an unresolvable ref is a HARD failure in strict hosts and MUST never silently degrade to a dangling id string.

aip.description: The referenced artifact's owning AIP number — the type discriminator that names the registry family (42 = app, 52 = pack, 14 = tool, …).

id.description: The artifact's registry key in its family — the same key the family's AIP-43 registry (or the family's keyBy) derives. Hosts MUST use the family's keyBy; a ref id and its registry key can never be allowed to drift.

version.description: OPTIONAL semver pin recording what was meant at authoring time. Absent = floating (resolve whatever is registered now). Pins are advisory metadata for hosts; AIP-43 registries do not version.
